description_en: Queries information about Cloud Connect Network (CCN) instances created in a specified region
description_zh: 查询指定地域下已创建的云连接网实例信息
kebab_example: aliyun smartag describe-cloud-connect-networks --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --name ccnname --ccn-id ccn-l9340rlu5enst00000 --page-size 10 --page-number 1 --tag Value=test Key=test --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeCloudConnectNetworks

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the Cloud Connect Network (CCN) instance
parameters.help_zh: 云连接网实例所属地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the Cloud Connect Network (CCN) instance.

The name must be 2 to 100 characters in length and must start with a letter or a Chinese character. It can contain digits, underscores (_), periods (.), and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh:
云连接网实例名称。

名称长度为2~100个字符，以大小写字母或中文开头，可包含数字、下划线（_）、半角句号（.）和短划线（-）
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the Cloud Connect Network (CCN)
parameters.name: ccn_id

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page in a paged query. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 50
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页包含的条目数，默认值为10，最大值为50
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The labels used to filter Cloud Connect Network (CCN) instances
parameters.help_zh: 通过标签信息查找云连接网实例
parameters.name: tag

CloudConnectNetwork.description_en: The list of Cloud Connect Network (CCN) instance information
CloudConnectNetwork.description_zh: 云连接网实例信息列表

items.description_en: The Cloud Connect Network (CCN) instance information

AssociatedCenId.description_en: The instance ID of the CEN instance attached to the Cloud Connect Network (CCN) instance
AssociatedCenId.description_zh: 云连接网实例绑定的云企业网实例ID

AssociatedCenOwnerId.description_en: The account ID of the Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance that has loaded the Cloud Connect Network (CCN) instance
AssociatedCenOwnerId.description_zh: 已加载该云连接网实例的云企业网实例的账号ID

AssociatedCenStatus.description_en: The association status of the CCN. This field is returned only when NewAgw is true. Valid values: Binding, Unbinding, BindFailed, UnbindFailed, Bound, and Unbound
AssociatedCenStatus.description_zh: CCN的绑定状态，只在NewAgw返回true时候才有值，有如下状态：Binding（绑定中）、Unbinding（解绑中）、BindFailed（绑定失败）、UnbindFailed（解绑失败）、Bound（已绑定）、Unbound（未绑定）

AssociatedCloudBoxCount.description_en: The number of Smart Access Gateway instances attached to the Cloud Connect Network (CCN) instance
AssociatedCloudBoxCount.description_zh: 云连接网实例绑定的智能接入网关实例数量

AvailableCloudBoxCount.description_en: The number of Smart Access Gateway instances in the active state among those attached to the Cloud Connect Network (CCN) instance
AvailableCloudBoxCount.description_zh: 云连接网实例已绑定的智能接入网关实例中状态为可用的智能接入网关实例的数量

CcnId.description_en: The instance ID of the Cloud Connect Network (CCN)

CenStatusErrorCode.description_en: The error code for a failed CEN association or disassociation. This field is returned only when NewAgw is true and AssociatedCenStatus is BindFailed or UnbindFailed
CenStatusErrorCode.description_zh: 绑定/解绑CEN失败错误码，只在 NewAgw 返回 true，且 AssociatedCenStatus 为 BindFailed/UnbindFailed 时才会返回

CenStatusErrorMessage.description_en: The error message for a failed CEN association or disassociation. This field is returned only when NewAgw is true and AssociatedCenStatus is BindFailed or UnbindFailed
CenStatusErrorMessage.description_zh: 绑定/解绑 CEN 失败错误消息，只在 NewAgw 返回 true，且 AssociatedCenStatus 为 BindFailed/UnbindFailed 时才会返回

CreateTime.description_en: The UNIX timestamp when the Cloud Connect Network (CCN) instance was created
CreateTime.description_zh: 云连接网实例的创建时间戳

Description.description_en: The description of the Cloud Connect Network (CCN) instance
Description.description_zh: 云连接网实例的描述信息

InterworkingStatus.description_en:
Indicates whether Smart Access Gateway instances attached to the same Cloud Connect Network (CCN) instance are allowed to communicate with each other.

enable: Allowed.
disable: Not allowed
InterworkingStatus.description_zh:
是否允许已绑定同一个云连接网实例的智能接入网关实例互通。

enable：允许。
disable：不允许

Name.description_en: The name of the Cloud Connect Network (CCN) instance

NewAgw.description_en: Indicates whether the Cloud Connect Network (CCN) is compatible with the new AGW

ProcessingCenId.description_en: The ID of the target CEN instance during an ongoing or failed association/disassociation operation. This field is returned only when NewAgw is true and AssociatedCenStatus is Binding, Unbinding, BindFailed, or UnbindFailed
ProcessingCenId.description_zh: 绑定/解绑进行中或失败时的目标 CEN ID。只在 NewAgw 返回 true，且 AssociatedCenStatus 为 Binding/Unbinding/BindFailed/UnbindFailed 时才会返回

ResourceGroupId.description_en: The ID of the resource group to which the Cloud Connect Network (CCN) instance belongs
ResourceGroupId.description_zh: 云连接网实例所属的资源组ID

Subnet.description_en: The Internet CIDR block used when the Cloud Connect Network (CCN) is attached to a CEN instance
Subnet.description_zh: 云连接网绑定云企业网使用的互联网段

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page in paging queries
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时每页包含的条目数
